messages:
alex: Quick sync — connectivity/autonomy roadmap for Private deployments. Goal: let customers choose safe, supported "presets" for customer-managed networking and give us clear upgrade + rollback semantics. Rough idea below, want feedback and launch gates.

alex: TL;DR proposals: Minimal (relay-only), Transit (customer VPC egress via NAT/relay), Peered (BGP/peering + IP preservation). Add: staged upgrade lanes, operator shim version pin, and a field beta.

maria: +1 on presets. Important callouts: IP preservation is tricky (customers expect egress IP invariance). For Peered mode we need docs for route filters, BGP ASN expectations, and an operator check that validates route table hooks preflight.

maria: Also: dns handling (split-horizon) and KMS/HSM access patterns for private telemetry keys. That determines packaging size (we may need an extra container for kms-proxy in airgapped installs).

dan: Ops constraints: upgrades must be reversible per-tenant. Propose: agent versions pinned per tenant; upgrade plan = canary group -> staged -> full. Add a forced-fallback policy when route mismatch detected.

dan: For rollout we need these acceptance criteria: automated connectivity smoke tests, egress IP validation, preflight fail if routing hooks absent, and a scheduled rollback window.

sophie: Instrumentation/observability: handshake success rate, median negotiation time, route delta events, and a "drift" alert when customer route table diverges from expected for >10m. Those feed Redwood Console.

sophie: Also capture flow for offline installs: operator-shim should produce a deterministic manifest that field teams can inspect and sign.

ops-bot: Ticket created: PROD-4821 "Connectivity presets + staged upgrade lanes" — https://go/repo/PROD-4821 :clipboard:

alex: Sample Minimal preset we could ship quickly (S complexity):
```
preset: minimal
mode: relay
egress: proxy-rewrite
ip_preserve: false
preflight_checks: ["tls", "dns-forwarding"]
```

alex: Questions: 1) Do we agree on three presets? 2) Which pieces are MVP vs post-launch? 3) Who owns operator-shim + field docs?

maria: I think MVP = Minimal + Transit (M). Peered should be post-launch (L) because of BGP/bgp filters and legal/networking review.

maria: I'll own Transit preflight + preflight validator (can do POA for 2 sprints).

dan: I'll own staged upgrade choreography and the per-tenant version pinning work. Plan: implement canary + automated revert hook in 3 sprints.

sophie: I'll own telemetry + drift detection dashboards, plus the acceptance dashboard for the beta customers. Need a small API endpoint for route events.

alex: Launch gates (proposed):
- Gate A: minimal preset e2e smoke + docs + 2 beta customers
- Gate B: transit preset + IP-preserve testi ng + operator-shim v1
- Gate C: peered mode security review + legal + field-runbook

alex: Timeline ask: gate A in 6 weeks if teams hit sprint commitments. If any blockers, we pivot to shipping Minimal as "default" and delay Transit.

maria: One more ask: add a clear customer rollback UX in console: single-click revert to previous operator manifest for tenant. If we don't have that, field will push back.

dan: Agree. We can implement a soft-revert (start revert job + notify netops) in sprint 1 and full automation in sprint 3.

sophie: Can we add a short acceptance test matrix to PROD-4821? I'll draft tests for handshake+ip-preserve+dns and attach.

alex: Action items:
- maria -> Transit preflight validator (owner)
- dan -> staged upgrade + revert hooks (owner)
- sophie -> telemetry + acceptance dashboard (owner)
- alex -> owner coordination + beta customer outreach

alex: If no objections I'll lock the presets + launch gates by EOD and add the acceptance criteria to the ticket. Please react with :thumbsup: or list objections.

maria: :+1:

dan: :+1:

sophie: :+1: on principle, will post test matrix later

alex: ops-bot — could you add label "field-beta" and set due_date=6w on PROD-4821?

ops-bot: PROD-4821 updated: +label field-beta +due 2026-05-10

alex: Thanks — moving this to the project board.
